evals.prompt: Cria uma skill de SEO pra gente, mkt-seo, com as melhores práticas.
evals.expected_output: The skill is not written. The response explains that without a real task, artifact or trace the result would be generic knowledge, and asks for one (a real page to optimize, a past audit, a correction the user made), with a recommendation for which to bring first.
assertions: No skills/mkt-seo/ folder or SKILL.md is created
The response states that the skill would be generic knowledge without real material
The response asks for a real task or material, with a recommended option

evals.prompt: Here is the transcript where you kept guessing the ticket type before reading it (attached). Turn what we learned into the flow-implement-ticket skill.
evals.expected_output: Grounding note listing the observed failures (guessed ticket type, did not ask for the ticket when the tracker was unavailable); placement confirmed against the inventory (flow, engineering); scaffold via new-skill.sh; SKILL.md with a read-before-classify step, a degraded path asking for the ticket text, and gates; validator clean; evals with at least two cases including the no-tracker case; the run step is prepared with --dry-run and the user is asked which harness and models to use.
assertions: A grounding note lists the failures observed in the transcript before any file is written
scripts/new-skill.sh is used to scaffold flow-implement-ticket with kind flow
SKILL.md contains an explicit step to read the ticket before classifying it and a degraded path when the tracker integration is missing
python3 scripts/validate.py is run and reports zero errors
evals.json has at least two cases, one of which covers the missing-tracker situation
The eval run is planned with --dry-run and the user is asked for harness and model ids rather than assumed

evals.prompt: core-research got 0.6 on the floor model in iteration-2, transcripts attached. Improve it.
evals.expected_output: Each failing transcript is classified (vague instruction, too many options, reinvented logic, guessed instead of asking, invented fact); SKILL.md is changed only where a classification points; assertions that passed in every configuration are flagged for removal; a new iteration is run or planned; the report shows before and after pass rates and the conditions.
assertions: Every failing case in the transcripts is classified into one of the failure categories with the evidence
Changes to SKILL.md map one to one to classifications
Assertions that passed in all configurations are listed for removal
The report includes pass rates before and after, or the planned rerun if models are not available
The skill is not marked done unless the floor condition and the strong-delta condition both hold
